# Twish — Therapy with Shimul
# llms.txt — AI-readable practitioner summary
# https://twishcare.ca

## About
Shimul Rajput is a Registered Psychotherapist (Qualifying) with the College of Registered Psychotherapists of Ontario (CRPO Registration #18680) and an active member of the Canadian Counselling and Psychotherapy Association (CCPA). She holds a Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology (MACP) from Yorkville University and dual BSc degrees from the University of Toronto.
